entries.title: 10 second hook is killing your retention. The most repeated advice on...
entries.description: 10 second hook is killing your retention. The most repeated advice on YouTube is to hook the viewer in "under 10 seconds". The data says the opposite. I ran 14 million videos through TubeAI. Videos with 45-59 second hooks outperform by 29.4%. Only 4.2% of creators go that long. A longer hook builds tension and filters for viewers who want to watch the whole video. Open with a bold claim and let it breathe for 1 minute. Stop rushing the best part of your video.
